prompts.Walk_S:
Edit this front-facing walking sprite sheet. Preserve the SAME exact adult male identity, adult proportions, headsize, colors, matte clothing, pouch on viewer right and delicate linework. Keep4columns2rows,8 figures, transparentbackground. Correct the WALK CYCLE poses only: current sequence repeats the same stride too much. Make8 genuinely consecutive classic walk phases in readingorder:
1 CONTACT: anatomical RIGHT foot extended FORWARD toward viewer with heel down, LEFT foot clearly behind; LEFT arm forward, RIGHT arm back.
2 DOWN: same RIGHT leg supports with bentknee; LEFT heel leavesground.
3 PASSING: RIGHT leg supports directly under pelvis; LEFT knee bendsforward, LEFT footpasses RIGHT ankle lifted.
4 UP: on RIGHT toe, LEFT leg reachingforward about tocontact, RIGHT arm swingingforward.
5 CONTACT: LEFT foot extended FORWARD towardviewer heel down, RIGHT footbehind; RIGHT arm forward, LEFT armback. Opposite of1.
6 DOWN: LEFT leg supports bentknee; RIGHT heel leavesground.
7 PASSING: LEFT leg supports directly underpelvis; RIGHT knee bendsforward, RIGHT footpassesLEFT ankle lifted. Opposite of3.
8 UP: onLEFTtoe RIGHTleg reachingforward abouttocontact, LEFTarmswingingforward. Opposite of4.
Do not repeat frame1 inframe4 orframe7. Do not lift a forwardshoe straight towardcamera as a kick: these are small natural walkingsteps. No jump, running or bothfeetoffground. Keepcalmopeneyes the same inallframes. Same bodypartlengths androotx inallframes, natural smallverticalbob, fixedgroundbaseline. No changing fine fabrictextures, shiny patches or randomnewwrinkles. Full headtofeet inclhands mustfitcells withoutcropping. No backgroundglow shadow text orlabels.

Classic8phases:1 RIGHT-foot-forward CONTACT, leftfootback, leftarmforward/rightarmback;2 DOWN onright supporting leg, supporting knee flexes, leftfootbeginsswing;3 PASSING onright supporting leg, leftkneeswingsforward pastpelvis;4 UP onrighttoe, leftlegreachesforward;5 LEFT-foot-forward CONTACT, rightfootback, rightarmforward/leftarmback;6 DOWN onleft support;7 PASSING onleft support, rightkneeswingsforward;8 UP onlefttoe, rightlegreaches for nextframe1.
